name: postgresql-workbench
description: PostgreSQL development workbench for VS Code with SQL notebooks, schema exploration, testing, coverage, and PL/pgSQL debugging

scripts.build: npm run build:dap && npm --prefix vscode-extension run compile && npm run build:ext
scripts.test: vitest run --exclude e2e/ --exclude vscode-extension/src/test/ && npm --prefix vscode-extension run test:scripts
scripts.test:e2e:run: npm run build:dap && vitest run e2e/ --exclude e2e/legacy-compat.test.ts --fileParallelism=false
scripts.test:e2e:lifecycle: npm run build:dap && vitest run e2e/debug-lifecycle.test.ts --fileParallelism=false
scripts.test:e2e:legacy:up: cd e2e && docker compose -f docker-compose.legacy.yml up -d --build --wait
scripts.test:e2e:legacy:run: npm run build:dap && vitest run e2e/legacy-compat.test.ts --fileParallelism=false
scripts.test:e2e:legacy:down: cd e2e && docker compose -f docker-compose.legacy.yml down -v
